explanation: Binary search between x and one when x<1, or one and x otherwise. Compare the squared midpoint with x using the reference’s relative epsilon, and stop once the interval endpoints are relatively equal.
timeComplexity: O(log(R/ε)) refinements for initial interval width R and attained absolute precision ε
